clause: StudioPrototypeFlow + StudioMotionTimeline authority tables + dated migrations [STU-PRO-001,STU-PRO-028,STU-CON-004]

scope.summary: Author forward-only SurrealKit rollouts for SCHEMAFULL prototyping/motion studio_* record types with typed record ids and required EventLedger record links: studio_prototype_flow (SPFL-), studio_prototype_interaction (SPIN-), studio_motion_timeline (SMTL-), studio_motion_keyframe (SMKF-). Interactive-document roles (buttons/forms/MSO) persist as typed fields on the owning studio_layer record (MT-004), not new record types. Every write uses the typed SurrealDB store under authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS; PostgreSQL and SQLite are forbidden.
acceptance_criteria: prototype/motion SCHEMAFULL records roll forward through SurrealKit on managed SurrealDB; interactive roles remain layer fields; PostgreSQL/SQLite rejected; typed-store and permissions proven
proof_targets: live SurrealDB namespace/database SurrealKit rollout + typed-store/write-permission test
expected_tests: live-SurrealDB: forward-only SurrealKit rollout applies cleanly and canonical records reread
test: no_legacy_database_tripwire rejects PostgreSQL/SQLite and any prototype/motion write outside the typed SurrealDB boundary
test: prefixed-id + event_ledger_event_id FK enforced on all four tables

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No durable prototype/motion authority store; flows and timelines cannot promote.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
